description: Topological mass formula (Vol(K)/ℏ_q² · λ_scale + Skein) evaluated at 50 dps for the Borromean baryon channel + the muon Vol(4_1)/ℏ_q² cross-check.  Substrate-only inputs: CAL-1 (m_e), CAL-2 (q_0), topological constants Vol(4_1), Vol(ℬ_3).  Reports the open λ_scale closure target empirically and verifies that the Skein-correction DIFFERENCE ΔS(n − p) is substrate-derivable from CAL-1 + CAL-2 alone (via Q_β closed form).
auditOnly: docs/audits/2026-05-11-why-individual-mass-residuals-fit-not-derive.md (motivates this Vol-form chain as Option B per the user's 'can we use m_e as mass scaling factor' question); PR #487 (introduced the Borromean-baryon-interpretation block with the formula and undefined λ_scale).
owner_directive_2026_05_11: Re-implement using m_e as scaling factor + Vol(K)/ℏ_q² as dimensionless multiplier per the canonical topological-mass formula; expose λ_scale as the single open derivation needed for 1ppb on individual hadron masses.

muon_cross_check.agreement_assertion: Vol(4_1)/ℏ_q² should reproduce CODATA m_μ/m_e exactly (this IS the CAL-2 q_0 calibration); checks the topological-mass formula's correctness.

borromean_common_factor.interpretation: Dimensionless 'common Borromean factor' shared by all Borromean baryons; physical baryon mass ratio is this value times the substrate λ_scale plus Skein correction.

lambda_scale_closure_targets.interpretation: Empirical λ_scale value required for the topological-mass formula to reproduce CODATA m_p / m_n.  THESE ARE VALIDATION VALUES — NOT inputs to the substrate derivation.  The substrate-derived λ_scale (from CAL-1 + CAL-2 alone) is OPEN; PR #487 introduced the formula but never defined λ_scale.  Open R&D item — see docs/audits/2026-05-11-why-individual-mass-residuals-fit-not-derive.md.

skein_correction_n_minus_p.agreement_assertion: ΔS(n − p) = (Q_β + m_e)/m_e / (Vol(ℬ_3)/ℏ_q²).  Substrate-derived from CAL-1 (m_e), CAL-2 (q_0 → Q_β via prop:neutron-qvalue-symbolic), and topological constant Vol(ℬ_3).  Empirical target is (m_n − m_p)/m_e / (Vol(ℬ_3)/ℏ_q²); the two should agree since Q_β = m_n − m_p − m_e by definition.

open_R_and_D.substrate_lambda_scale: Derive λ_scale from CAL-1 + CAL-2 + topological invariants of ℬ_3 alone.  Empirical closure target ≈ 2.460.  Candidates checked at q_0 (from the candidate sweep in the linked audit) — none of [n]_q, q^k, m_μ/m_e/84, etc. matches to better than 0.06%.  Open.
open_R_and_D.substrate_skein_correction_per_orientati: Derive S(p), S(n) (not just the difference) from the Borromean orientation partition (k positive, 3-k negative) via the Skein polynomial.  Empirical: |S(n) − S(p)| ≈ 0.00339 dimensionless; the difference IS substrate-derivable per ΔS formula above.  Open: the individual S(p), S(n) anchored to a common substrate quantity.
